_doc: The bars a strategy must clear to advance a rung. This file is part of the frozen control plane: the agent may propose a change in writing, but it may not edit it. Tightening these numbers is how the desk gets more selective over time.

research._doc: RESEARCH -> PAPER. Offline evidence only, so the bar is 'is this worth spending live data collection on'.

paper._doc: PAPER -> READY. The expensive gate. Every number here must be computed from the settled ledger, never typed by hand.

kill._doc: Any one of these true and the strategy is retired. Killing is cheap and reversible; capital is not.

panel._doc: A PROCEED verdict older than this reviewed a different set of facts.

live._doc: LIVE additionally requires the spend gate to approve the worst-case loss. With the cap at $0 a strategy parks at READY until an operator funds it — which is exactly what happened.
